description: This Java class defines the response type for a 'ModifyThing' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, handling serialization, deserialization, and providing accessors for response data including the modified or created Thing entity.

classes.name: ModifyThingResponse
classes.description: Response class for handling the outcome of a ModifyThing command, containing information about the status, the created or modified Thing, and relevant headers.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a Thing was created, with HTTP 201 status.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response object indicating a Thing was modified, with HTTP 204 status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a ModifyThingResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the affected Thing.

methods.name: getThingCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Thing if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the Thing entity, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Provides the JSON pointer path to the resource, which is empty in this case.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into a JSON object builder.
